program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((frame-bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 5)))
         (seeds (filter (lambda (cell) (and (not (= (third cell) 0)) (not (= (third cell) 5))))
                        (grid-cells g))))
    (define (dist cell r c)
      (+ (abs (- r (first cell))) (abs (- c (second cell)))))
    (define (fill-value r c)
      (let* ((dmin (apply min (map (lambda (cell) (dist cell r c)) seeds)))
             (colors (remove-duplicates (map third (filter (lambda (cell) (= (dist cell r c) dmin)) seeds)))))
        (if (= (length colors) 1) (first colors) 0)))
    (for*/fold ([out g])
               ([r (in-range (+ (first frame-bb) 1) (third frame-bb))]
                [c (in-range (+ (second frame-bb) 1) (fourth frame-bb))])
      (if (= (at out r c) 0) (set-cell out r c (fill-value r c)) out))))
